param.name: Include
param.description: Append the gamedata parameters from the specified CSV file to this entity.

param.name: Name
param.description: Unique identifier for this entity to be referenced by other entities, scripting, etc.

param.name: AttachBone
param.description: Parents entity with the name of another entity's bone

param.name: InWorld
param.description: Makes an entity invisible and intangible. Useful if you want to spawn entity with a script

param.name: HealthContainer
param.description: Max number of life batteries for this entity. ( e.g., 2 = two batteries ).

param.name: Health
param.description: The number of fully filled life batteries for this entity, with fractions giving partial batteries ( e.g., 1.5 = one and a half batteries )

param.name: ArmorProfile
param.description: Uses an entry in armor.csv as armor. Use nohitpoint if entity recieves no damage

param.name: ArmorBullet
param.description: Replaced with ArmorProfile

param.name: ArmorFlame
param.description: Replaced with ArmorProfile

param.name: ArmorExplosion
param.description: Replaced with ArmorProfile

param.name: Attach
param.description: Parents entity with another entity so they move together

param.name: Goodie
param.description: Item in bag, first two digits are amount of item and must be the same

param.name: GoodieBag
param.description: Replaced with Goodie

param.name: Tripper
param.description: TRUE if this entity can activate tripwire triggers.

param.name: IsTargetable
param.description: Replaced with Targetable

param.name: Sound_Ambient_Tag
param.description: Sound Wav name or sfb tag to play

param.name: Sound_Ambient_Volume
param.description: Sound volume

param.name: Sound_Ambient_Radius
param.description: The distance from this entity the sound will linearly falloff from in audibility,

param.name: Sound_Ambient_Off
param.description: Whether the sound should start off

param.name: ProjReact
param.description: Default | Ricochet | DeathToAll | Sticky | HurtMe | Shield

param.name: TalkData
param.description: Name of the BTA ( Bot Talk Action ) .csv to load and play for this bot instance.

param.name: TalkInst_HighPri
param.description: TRUE if this bot instance is allowed to interrupt an in progress BTA ( Bot Talk Action ) with it's own.

param.name: TalkInst_GiveChip
param.description: TRUE if this bot instance will give the player a chip when finished with it's BTA. ( Bot Talk Action )

param.name: TalkInst_TriggerEventStart
param.description: TRUE if this bot instance will trigger a script event when starting it's BTA. ( Bot Talk Action )

param.name: TalkInst_TriggerEventEnd
param.description: TRUE if this bot instance will trigger a script event when finished it's BTA. ( Bot Talk Action )

param.name: DataPort
param.description: Set the state of the dataport used by the control tether for this bot instance. ( None, Close, Closed, Open, Opened )

param.name: PossessDist
param.description: Set the distance this bot instance is allowed to walk from it's posession point before being forcefully ejected. ( 100.0 ( Min Distance ) - 100000.0 (Max Distance ) )

param.name: DisguiseTIme
param.description: Set the time it takes for this bot instance to be discovered as posessed and be attacked. ( 0.0 ( Immediate ) - 100000.0 ( Never ) )

param.name: MeshVersion
param.description: Set the index for a replacement .ape mesh to use for this bot instance. Replacement meshes are hardcoded by bot. ( Corrosive, Glitch and Grunt Only )

param.name: MeshReplace
param.description: Set the name of the replacement .ape model to load for this bot instance. Bones must match. ( Glitch, Grunt, Krunk, Miner, Mortar, Mozer, Slosh, zombiebot king Only )

param.name: Sleeping
param.description: TRUE if this bot instance should not notice the player until alerted by noise or attacked.

param.name: PowerDownUntilPosessed
param.description: TRUE if this bot instance should be turned off until posessed or recruited.

param.name: RunMultiplier
param.description: The maximum running speed for this bot instance ( 1.0 ( Walking ) - 100.0 ( Full Sprint ) )

param.name: NPCWeapon0
param.description: Set the primary weapon this bot should use ( HAND, LASER, SPEW, FLAMER, BLASTER, ROCKET, RIVET ) ( Miner and Grunt Only )

param.name: NPCWeapon1
param.description: Set the secondary weapon this bot should use ( HAND, GRENADE ) ( Grunt only )

param.name: KeepLimb
param.description: Set the following limbs to never dislodge or break ( Head | Torso | Arms | Legs | | Wings | RL | Light | Misc | All ) ( TODO: Bot Limb Table )

param.name: SpotLightOn
param.description: TRUE if this bot instance should enable it's light to illuminate the environment.

param.name: CanBeRecruited
param.description: TRUE if this bot instance can be converted to the player's team by the recruiter grenade. A recruiter grenade symbol will appear above this bot's head for indication.

param.name: Babble
param.description: TRUE if this bot instance should pitch shift and distort it's voice when speaking.

param.name: CanBeRecruitedWithoutDataport
param.description: TRUE if this bot instance can be recruited by a recruiter grenade without needing a dataport opened.

param.name: NoEmp
param.description: TRUE if this bot instance should not be affected by emp grenades

group.name: Physics
group.description: Parameters related to the Verlet Integration Physics Implementation. Sourced from the 2001 paper Advanced Character Physics by Thomas Jakobsen.

param.name: Physics
param.description: TRUE if this entity should enable all the bones tagged for verlet integration physics simulation for it's corresponding .ape mesh

param.name: PhysFreeze
param.description: TRUE if this entity starts with no active physics. Can be unfrozen to enable physics via scripting

param.name: PhysFreezeWhenStill
param.description: TRUE if this entity should freeze itself once it becomes motionless and stops moving

param.name: PhysDieWhenCollide
param.description: TRUE if this entity should Auto-die when the Verlet object passes through a surface

param.name: PhysMass
param.description: Resistance of change for this entity. The higher this value, the harder and more force required to move this object.

param.name: PhysDampening
param.description: ( 0.0 - 1.0 ) Set the intensity for this entity to gradually come to rest when under physics to move, the higher the value the more relaxed the motion.

param.name: PhysPrimeSecs
param.description: Number of seconds ( 0 - 60 ) specifying delay this entity enables physics after they have been enabled.

param.name: PhysGravity
param.description: Gravity of the object, negative values

param.name: PhysDim
param.description: Physics diminishment. Higher number reduces physics on x, y, or z

param.name: PhysAnchorEnable
param.description: PhysAnchorEnable tackname, on/off - TRUE if setting the corresponding tack for this entity to simulate physics.

param.name: PhysAnchorNone
param.description: PhysAnchorNone tackname - Set the name of the coresponding tack for this entity to not be anchored.

param.name: PhysAnchorToInitialPos
param.description: PhysAnchorToInitialPos tackname - Set the anchor point to the tack position making this tack static ( ??? VERIFY THIS )

param.name: PhysAnchorToAnotherTack
param.description: PhysAnchorToAnotherTack tackname, anchorentityname, anchortackname - ...

param.name: PhysAnchorToStaticEntity
param.description: PhysAnchorToStaticEntity tackname, anchorentityname - ...

param.name: PhysAnchorToDynamicEntity
param.description: PhysAnchorToDynamicEntity tackname, anchorentityname - ...

param.name: PhysAnchorRange
param.description: PhysAnchorRange tackname, mindist, maxdist - Distance between tack and anchor point in meters

param.name: PhysAnchorDraw
param.description: PhysAnchorDraw tackname, wire_style_code - Draw a wire connecting tack to the anchor point. Style value sets the color of the wire. 1=Grey, 2=Black, 3=Red, 4=Violet, 5=Green, 6=Brown, 7=Orange, 8=Tan

param.name: PhysAnchorSlice
param.description: PhysAnchorSlice tackname, on/off - Allow this anchor point to be severed from the tack.

param.name: PhysAnchorHealth
param.description: PhysAnchorHealth tackname, health - Amount of damage ( 0 - 100000 ) this anchor can sustain before breaking connection with it's tack.

param.name: PhysAnchorArmorProfile
param.description: The name of a corresponding entry from armor.csv controlling the intensity of damage taken from an attacking type. ( Projectiles, Explosives, Fire, etc. )

param.name: PhysAnchorExplosionProfile
param.description: The name of a corresponding entry from explsn_grps.csv controlling ( when this anchor is destroyed ??? VERIFY THIS )

param.name: PhysCollSurf
param.description: List of Verlet Collision Surfaces this entity can collide with, not setting this will cause the entity to collide with nothing, falling through the ground.

group.name: AI
group.description: Parameters related to controlling bot behavior.

param.name: AI_JOB
param.description: Set the initial action this AI entity will follow ( WAIT, WANDER, PATROL )

param.name: AI_AGGRESSION
param.description: Higher values cause this bot to fire more shots and search longer when losing line of sight with target.

param.name: AI_COURAGE
param.description: Setting to higher numbers will cause this bot entity to behave more agressively and more likely to kamikazee vs fleeing when at low health.

param.name: AI_INTELLIGENCE
param.description: If set to 100, Titans will aim their rockets at the feet of targets instead of the chest. setting to 100 along with courage and agression for zombiebots will make them deform at spawn point if lost track of target.

param.name: AI_GREETINGLEVEL
param.description: Greeting code was removed.

param.name: AI_LOD_OVERRIDE_WHEN_CONVENIENT
param.description: Game code never sets when it would be convenient to override making this useless.

param.name: AI_RACE
param.description: Set the faction this ai entity belongs to determing who it will fight against, ally with and be neutral towards. ( MIL, DROID, ZOMBIE, AMBIENT ) ( Obsolete Good, Evil )

param.name: AI_JUMPDIST
param.description: Override this bot's maximum vert 2 vert jump distance

param.name: AI_WANDERSTAYINROOM
param.description: Does not work because game code always returns room ID 0.

param.name: AI_WANDERSOCIABLE
param.description: Parameter exists but does nothing.

param.name: AI_PREFERSTOPANDSHOOT
param.description: TRUE for while in combat this entity will come to a complete stop before firing at it's target.

param.name: AI_ATTACKRULESET
param.description: The combat strategy to use when fighting against another combatant. ( GENERIC0, GENERIC1, NPC, TITAN0, PRED0, PROBE0, RAT0, ELITEGUARD0, ZOMBIE0, CORROSIVE0, ZOMBIEBOSS0, JUMPER0, JUMPER1, SCIENTIST0, NONE )

param.name: AI_ALTATTACKRULESET
param.description: Not implemented.

param.name: AI_ALTATTACKRULESETODDS
param.description: Not implemented.

param.name: AI_ATTACKSPEEDMIN
param.description: Minimum Percentage speed ( 0 - 100 ) This entity is allowed to run at while in combat.

param.name: AI_ATTACKSPEEDMAX
param.description: Maximum Percentage speed ( 0 - 100 ) This entity is allowed to run at while in combat.

param.name: AI_STAYPUTDIST
param.description: While in combat, AI will stay in position as long as this set distance is greater than it's current distance to it's target.

param.name: AI_ATTACKWHO
param.description: Specify the targets this bot entity will fight against. ( ENEMY | NEUTRAL | FRIENDLY ) ( PLAYERS | NPC ) ( TODO: How does this work? )

param.name: AI_USEVEHICLERADIUS
param.description: When the bot decides to query for a vehicle the radius it should search for an unoperated vehicle starting from it's position.

param.name: AI_USEVEHICLEWHEN
param.description: Specify when this AI will attempt to use vehicles ( NONE, AUTO, INIT )

param.name: AI_USEVEHICLETYPE
param.description: Specify the types of vehicles this bot entity is allowed to use ( "NONE | PILL | LOADER | SENTINEL | RAT | RATGUN )

param.name: AI_NEVERUNARMED
param.description: Set the bot flag BRAINFLAG_NEVER_UNARMED. ( TODO: How does this affect bot behavior? )

param.name: AI_COMM_GROUP
param.description: TEST ME! - Set a group this entity is apart of that will notify the each other when one enters combat.
